directives.title: Tiered governance control spine is provisionally adopted
directives.source: Ken approval of docs/independent-governance-audit.md with Standing Orders revisions, 2026-08-15
directives.requirement: Apply the tiered control spine while preserving progress; reassess it after observed use rather than treating it as permanently settled.

acceptanceTests.expected: Session gate passes while scoped holds leave unrelated Tier 0 and Tier 2 work available
Observed control failures or unnecessary friction are revised, not normalized

directives.blockScope: Controls remain scoped to the named boundary and must not create a project-wide pause.
directives.nextSafeAction: Run the session and action gates as work proceeds; record the first observed successes and failures.

directives.title: Progress is the primary mandate
directives.source: docs/elevated-auditor-brief-for-review.md section 1; approved audit assignment of 2026-08-15
directives.requirement: Governance must enable safe forward motion. Tier 0 work proceeds without approval, and every scoped blocker names the smallest correction plus parallel safe work.

acceptanceTests.expected: Tier 0 never fails solely because another subsystem is held
Every BLOCK has a scope, owner, correction, evidence, and parallel work

directives.blockScope: A failure blocks only the named action or promotion unless control-file integrity itself is broken.
directives.nextSafeAction: Continue local inspection, tests, documentation, fixtures, and rollback preparation.

directives.title: Missed safe-progress obligations are failures
directives.source: Ken directive: 'Progress is the mandate. Failure is failure.', 2026-08-16
directives.requirement: A scoped hold must not suppress an independent allowed baseline, telemetry path, local test, review, or pull-only support mode. Missing a standing-order obligation is reported as a failure with its effect, smallest correction, owner, and clearing evidence; it is never relabeled as caution or ambiguity.

acceptanceTests.expected: A hold blocks only its named action while independent safe work continues
An unrelated hold cannot block an allowed support, telemetry, inspection, or local-work path

directives.blockScope: A named safety hold remains narrow; failure to preserve independent safe progress is itself a control failure requiring immediate correction, not a project-wide pause.
directives.nextSafeAction: Keep a progress controller actively assigned for the whole work cycle; continue the highest-value allowed path and emit a timestamped progress update with evidence and any real scoped block.

directives.title: Standing Orders restores the operational control loop
directives.requirement: The instruction 'Standing Orders' is an operational re-entry command. Codex restores current control state, a persistent progress controller, observable status through the narrowest allowed path, a timestamped progress ping, and the next highest-value safe action without waiting for further prompting.

acceptanceTests.expected: Session re-entry continues independent safe work despite scoped holds
Any re-entry block names its scope, correction, owner, evidence, and parallel safe work

directives.blockScope: A dropped session may lose live agents but never suspends repository controls or safe progress; only a named action gate can block its named live boundary.
directives.nextSafeAction: Run the session-reentry sequence and establish a persistent progress controller.

directives.title: Codex overlay preserves but overrides Claude workflow rules
directives.source: Ken directive approving the AGENTS.md overlay, 2026-08-15
directives.requirement: Leave CLAUDE.md untouched for Claude's return; for Codex, the explicit AGENTS.md overlay controls any conflicting repository-local workflow instruction.

acceptanceTests.expected: AGENTS.md declares the repository-local precedence and preserved CLAUDE.md boundary

directives.blockScope: Missing precedence is REVIEW_REQUIRED for live action, not a block on Tier 0 analysis.
directives.nextSafeAction: Use the machine-readable ledger while correcting the overlay.

directives.title: Current claims require typed evidence
directives.source: docs/standing-orders.md sections Evidence standards and Completion definition
directives.requirement: Distinguish static, local, live, telemetry, exploratory, and independent evidence; a live-confirmed claim must retain source identity and a retrievable run artifact.

acceptanceTests.expected: Every current claim states classification, evidence class, what it proves, and what it does not prove
live-confirmed claims include sourceVersion, observedAt, runId, and an existing retained artifact

directives.blockScope: A missing live artifact blocks the dependent live claim or promotion only; documentation debt is WARN.
directives.nextSafeAction: Downgrade the claim to reported/unknown or retrieve and attest the artifact.

directives.title: Edits in the synced checkout are deployment-capable
directives.source: AGENTS.md file-sync constraints and tools/bb_remote.py WATCHED_FILES behavior
directives.requirement: An edit to WATCHED_FILES in the connected synced checkout is deployment-capable and is not Tier 0. Local source development belongs in a non-synced worktree until an action gate permits promotion.

acceptanceTests.expected: Dirty watched source is reported and blocks only restart/promotion of its subsystem
Clean/scoped state is required at commit, merge, deployment, and promotion, not harmless analysis

directives.blockScope: Dirty watched source blocks executing or promoting the affected subsystem until source identity is attested.
directives.nextSafeAction: Continue in governance files or a non-synced worktree; attest the exact source before live execution.

directives.title: Established core MCP baseline may operate
directives.source: Ken directive approving startup.js for the core MCP baseline, 2026-08-15
directives.requirement: startup.js may start the established core MCP, crawler, supervisor, HUD, and stats baseline without a fresh approval; health and recovery evidence remain required.

acceptanceTests.expected: core-mcp is operational-baseline
startup.js contains no held subsystem

directives.blockScope: Only a failed core source, health, or rollback condition blocks the baseline.
directives.nextSafeAction: Run local checks or repair the precise failed core condition; held subsystems remain independent.

directives.title: No stock capital deployment
directives.source: AGENTS.md stock rule; reconfirmed by current operating directive, 2026-08-15
directives.requirement: No buy, sell, short, order, or other capital-moving stock call may be synced, executed, committed, or promoted without a narrow active approval record.

acceptanceTests.expected: Capital-moving APIs are absent from promotable source unless an active approval and approved promotion state name the file
stock-trader remains quarantined without approval

directives.blockScope: Block only stock-trader sync, execution, commit, or promotion.
directives.nextSafeAction: Continue read-only market analysis or remove/quarantine capital-moving source in a separately approved cleanup.
